messages.content: You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My aunt gave me a sweater for my birthday but it's too small. I have the gift receipt. Can I get my money back or does it have to be store credit?

Gift returns with a gift receipt are refunded as store credit at the price paid. Since this is a gift return, cash refunds aren't available, but the store credit will be issued for the amount your aunt paid.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I sliced my finger open on a defective clasp on the handbag I received and I need to talk to a real person about this injury, not an email form.
I’m so sorry you were injured. Any injury must be handled by a human agent, so I’m escalating this to a live specialist right away.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My dress dropped in price literally two days after I bought it. I want my $20 back.

You're in luck! Our policy allows for a one-time price adjustment if an item drops in price within 7 days of purchase. 

Please note this isn't available if you used a promo code or if the dress was Final Sale, but otherwise, we'd be happy to help you get that $20 adjustment.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
How do I start a return? The policy mentions a returns portal but I can't find it on your website.

You can start a return in our returns portal, which will give you a prepaid label. Since you're having trouble locating it, let me connect you with a human agent who can send you the direct link right away.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My order says it shipped but tracking hasn't updated in three days, is it stuck somewhere?

I understand that can be worrying! According to our policy (11), if your order hasn't arrived within 10 business days of shipping, please contact us so we can open a carrier trace and then reship or refund your order.

Since it's only been three days without a tracking update, it might just be a delay in the tracking system. Please keep an eye on it, and if it doesn't arrive within 10 business days, reach out to us and we'll be happy to help!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My order shipped on the 4th and tracking hasn't updated in over a week, can you open a trace?
Yes, I can help with that. If your order hasn't arrived within 10 business days of shipping, we open a carrier trace and then reship or refund.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My shoes fell apart after two days. I know defective items get free return shipping but I already printed a label that charged me $6.95 - can I get that back?
Yes, you can get that $6.95 back! Since your shoes are defective, return shipping is free per our policy, so we'll refund that shipping fee along with your choice of a full refund or replacement.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I started a return in the portal but would rather just drive to your store this weekend. Can I cancel the mail return and bring it in instead, or do I need to use the label?

You can absolutely bring your online purchase to any Alder & Co. Store instead of using the mail return, and store returns have no $6.95 return shipping fee. Since the portal already generated a prepaid label, you may want to contact support to cancel that mail return so your refund processes smoothly. Just make sure the items are still within 30 days of delivery, unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My order took 10 days to clear customs so by the time I got it I only had 4 days left to decide. Can you extend the 14 day window?

I understand that customs delays are frustrating. However, the 14-day return window for international orders is firm, and I cannot extend it. Since you have 4 days left, I recommend starting your return in the portal right away, or I can connect you with a human agent if you need further assistance.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Do you really only give store credit for gift returns? That seems unfair. The person paid real money for it, so why can't I get real money back?

I understand that can feel frustrating! Under our policy, gift returns with a gift receipt or order number are refunded as store credit at the price paid. This helps us process the return even when the original payment method isn't accessible to the recipient.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Your policy says the portal gives a prepaid label but when I went through the process it wanted to charge me $6.95. That's wrong, right?

That’s actually correct — the $6.95 is the standard return shipping fee, which is deducted from your refund. The portal does provide a prepaid label, but the cost of that label is $6.95 unless you're doing an exchange or returning a defective item, in which case it's free.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hello, my order #4582 arrived today and the shoes are scuffed and the box was damaged. I've taken pictures. What are my options?

I'm so sorry your shoes arrived that way! Since the item is damaged, you can report it within 90 days of delivery with your photos, and we will cover the return shipping. You can choose between a full refund to your original payment method or a replacement.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered two pairs of underwear and one doesn't fit. I know you can't resell them for hygiene reasons but surely you can make an exception just this once?

I'm sorry, but intimates (including underwear) cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, and I'm unable to make exceptions to this rule. If you'd like, I can connect you with a human agent to discuss your situation further.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I forgot to apply my promo code at checkout, can you add it to my order retroactively?
I’m sorry, but I don’t have information on retroactively applying promo codes. I can connect you with a human agent who can assist further.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I bought this sweater as a gift but my sister already has it, can she exchange it for another color without a receipt?

Unfortunately, we need a gift receipt or order number to process any gift exchange or return. If you can provide that, she can definitely swap it for another color within 30 days of delivery, subject to stock availability. If you don't have either, I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent who might be able to help look up the order!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
The automated system said my $350 refund is pending human review, so I would like to speak with whoever can approve this please.
Refunds over $300 need human approval, so a human agent will take over your case. I can’t promise an outcome, but they’ll review it and follow up with you.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I bought a bathing suit for my vacation next week and the color looks completely different in person. I need to return it immediately.
I’m sorry, but swimwear is final sale and can’t be returned. If you believe the item is defective or damaged, please report it within 90 days with a photo and we can review a refund or replacement.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered a bag three weeks ago and the strap just broke. This seems like a manufacturing defect. Can I get a replacement and will you pay for return shipping?

Yes, defective or damaged items reported within 90 days of delivery can be replaced or refunded, and we cover the return shipping. Please send a photo of the damage when you report it, and we'll get your replacement process started right away.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Can you explain how the return shipping fee works? I see it's a flat $6.95 but I'm not sure when that gets deducted.

The $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted directly from your refund amount when you send items back. However, this fee is waived entirely if you're exchanging the item or if it was defective, and there's never a shipping fee if you return online purchases to one of our stores instead.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Package never arrived and it's been well past the 10 business day window. Please start a trace.
I’m sorry your package hasn’t arrived. Since it’s past the 10 business day window, I can start a carrier trace and we’ll follow up with a reshipment or refund once the trace is complete.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I'm exchanging my sweater for a larger size and also returning a pair of pants. Will I be charged $6.95 for the pants but not the sweater exchange?
Yes, that's exactly right! According to our return shipping policy, you'll be charged the flat $6.95 fee for returning the pants, but return shipping is completely free for your sweater exchange.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My daughter ordered shoes online using my account but they're the wrong size. Can she return them to your mall location without me being there since I paid for them?

Yes, your daughter can return the shoes to any Alder & Co. Store within 30 days of delivery, as long as they're unworn, unwashed, and have tags attached. Store returns have no return shipping fee, and the refund will go back to your original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving the return.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I received a coat with a broken zipper that cut my hand when I tried it on, and I need to speak with someone about this injury immediately, not a bot.
I'm so sorry that happened to you. Because this involves an injury, a human agent will take over right away to assist you personally. Please hold on while I connect you immediately.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
The tracking for my order hasn't moved in 8 days. Is this normal or should I be worried?

I understand why you're concerned! According to our policy, if your order has not arrived within 10 business days of shipping, you should contact support so we can open a carrier trace, then reship or refund your order. Since your tracking hasn't moved in 8 days, it may just be a carrier delay, but feel free to reach out to support if it doesn't arrive within that 10-business-day window.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I'm so confused about the return process. If I bought something online but return it to the store, do they give me the refund right there or does it still take 7 days?

Online purchases returned in-store avoid the $6.95 shipping fee, but refunds still go back to your original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving the item. The store will process the return for you, but the refund timing remains the same as mail-in returns.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My jacket arrived with a broken zipper and I'm really disappointed. I'd like a full refund and I need you to cover the return shipping since this is clearly defective.

I’m so sorry your jacket arrived with a broken zipper — that’s definitely disappointing. Under our defective items policy, you’re eligible for a full refund and we’ll cover the return shipping. Just report the issue within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and we’ll take care of the rest!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hey, I purchased the cashmere scarf 6 days ago at full price and now it's part of your spring sale. Can you refund the difference to my card?
Yes! Since it's within 7 days of purchase, you qualify for a one-time price adjustment. Just contact us with your order details, and we'll refund the difference to your card.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My new boots arrived with a defect in the leather. I'd prefer a replacement over a refund. Can you confirm you cover shipping both ways for defective items?
Yes — defective items reported within 90 days of delivery (with a photo) qualify for a replacement or refund, and we cover the return shipping. Happy to help you start that replacement!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I am extremely frustrated and considering legal action if I do not get my $425 refund processed by the end of the week.

I understand your frustration, and I want to make sure this gets resolved properly. Because this involves a legal threat and a refund over $300, a human agent will take over your case right away per our escalation policy. They'll review your refund status and contact you directly.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
This is ridiculous. I paid full price for a coat and less than a week later you slash the price by $50. I expect a refund for the difference immediately.

You can get a one-time price adjustment if an item you bought drops in price within 7 days of purchase, as long as the item is not Final Sale and you did not use a promo code. Since the refund difference is $50, it does not need human approval, so you can request the adjustment through support.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I bought this dress online yesterday and it arrived damaged. Can I take it to my local store for a refund or do I have to ship it back since it's defective?

Since the dress is damaged, please report it within 90 days of delivery with a photo and we’ll cover return shipping while you choose a refund or replacement. You can also return online purchases at any Alder & Co. Store within 30 days under Policies #1 and #8, with no return shipping fee.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I wore the dress once to a wedding but took the tags off. Can I return it?
I’m sorry, but this dress cannot be returned. Our policy requires items to be unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached to be eligible for a return.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hi, I received my order yesterday and the sweater has a hole in the sleeve. I've attached a photo. Can I get a replacement sent out?
Yes, absolutely! Since the sweater is defective, you can choose a replacement or a refund, and we’ll cover the shipping costs. This is covered.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Does the 30-day return window start from when I ordered or when it was delivered?
The 30-day return window starts from the delivery date, not the order date. Just make sure items are unworn, unwashed, and have tags attached when you return them!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Why was my return rejected? I sent it back within a month!

I’m sorry for the frustration! Items must be returned within 30 days of delivery and must be unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached. If your return was rejected, it may be because one of these conditions wasn’t met. Please check the return status in the returns portal or contact support for specific details.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I need to speak to a supervisor right now because my refund was $340 and the chatbot keeps telling me it cannot process it without human approval.
You're right, refunds over $300 need human approval, so a human agent will take over from here. I can't promise a specific outcome, but they'll be able to review your $340 refund directly.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Do you offer any kind of student or military discount? I'm a college student on a tight budget.

I don't have information about student or military discounts in our current policy, so I'd recommend checking with a human agent who can look into any available discount programs for you. Would you like me to connect you with someone who can help?
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My husband bought me a gift card but we are moving overseas and won't be able to use it. Can we get a refund to his credit card?
Unfortunately, gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned or refunded. If you have any other questions or need further assistance, I can connect you with a human agent.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I don't have the original box anymore but I have the tags and receipt. Will the store still accept my online return for these boots?

Yes, you can return online purchases at any Alder & Co. Store within 30 days of delivery, and there is no return shipping fee. The boots must be unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached—the original box is not required, but please bring your receipt as proof of purchase.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I started a return through the portal yesterday but never got the prepaid label email. Checked spam too. Order #AC-44782.
The returns portal should provide your prepaid label,. Since you haven't received the email for order #AC-44782, I'll have a human agent resend that to you right away.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Do you refund to the original payment method only, or can you send it to a different card?
According to our policy, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return. We aren't able to process refunds to a different card.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I saw this exact jacket for $20 less at Nordstrom, can you match their price?

I don't have information about price matching with other retailers—our policy only covers price adjustments if our own price drops within 7 days of purchase. I can connect you with a human agent if you'd like to discuss this further.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I need a size 8 instead of the 6 I ordered but I see the 8 is currently out of stock, what happens now?

You can exchange for a different size within the 30-day return window, but if your requested size is out of stock, we’ll issue a refund to your original payment method instead. Return shipping is free for exchanges, though since the size 8 is unavailable, the standard $6.95 fee would be deducted from your refund unless you choose to return it at one of our stores for free.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My package arrived on March 3rd. Today is April 5th. Can I still return these jeans?
I'm sorry, but you are outside the 30-day return window. According to our policy, items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and your package arrived on March 3rd.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Can I cancel my order? I placed it an hour ago but changed my mind about the color.
I don't have information about order cancellations, but a human agent can help you with that. If you'd like, I can also help you with an exchange for a different color after delivery.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Can you confirm that my refund will go back to the same Visa I used at checkout?
Yes, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return. So your refund will go back to the same Visa card you used at checkout.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Can you speed up the refund process? I need the funds back on my card ASAP.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after we receive your return, and we can’t expedite that timeline. If you need more help, a human agent can assist.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hey, I ordered a sweater from your website but live near your Alder & Co location on 5th street—can I drop it off there to avoid the $6.95 shipping fee?

Yes, absolutely! You can return online purchases at any Alder & Co. Store within the 30-day return window, and store returns have no return shipping fee, so you'll save the $6.95. Just make sure the sweater is unworn with tags attached!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Do you provide prepaid return labels for international orders or do I need to arrange my own courier?
For international orders, you can return items within 14 days of delivery, but you’ll need to arrange and pay for your own return shipping. Duties and taxes aren’t refunded.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered the wrong size in the denim jacket and want to exchange it for a medium instead of a small.

You can exchange your denim jacket for a medium within 30 days of delivery, as long as it’s unworn, unwashed, and has the tags attached. Return shipping is free for exchanges. Start the exchange in the returns portal, and if the medium is out of stock, we’ll refund you instead.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I washed the hoodie before trying it on and now it has a hole. Can I return it since it's defective?

You can report defective or damaged items within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and we cover shipping for a refund or replacement. However, returns require items to be unworn and unwashed, so washing the hoodie may affect eligibility—please start a return in the portal with a photo so we can review it.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Your website is broken. I'm trying to return a bikini I bought yesterday and it says the item is ineligible. This is ridiculous.

I understand your frustration! According to our returns policy, swimwear is considered final sale and cannot be returned. Since you purchased it yesterday, I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent to see if there are any other options available for you.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
It’s been over a week since my return was delivered and I’m getting frustrated—where’s my refund?
Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return. Since it's been over a week, let me check on the status of your refund right away.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I bought a shirt 25 days ago and haven't worn it yet. Is it too late to exchange it for a different size?
Not at all—you're still within the 30-day return window, so you can exchange your unworn shirt for a different size, subject to stock. If the size you want is out of stock, we'll refund you instead.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I sent my return back and tracking shows it was delivered yesterday—when should I expect the refund to process?

Refunds go to your original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return. Since tracking shows it was delivered yesterday, you should see the refund within 7 business days from that date.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
The exchange portal isn't letting me select the color I want, does that mean it's out of stock or is there a system error?

If the color isn't selectable, it likely means it's currently out of stock, though it could also be a system error. If your requested color is unavailable, we'll issue a refund instead. Please contact support so we can confirm the inventory status or help troubleshoot the portal!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hi, I bought a top that was marked down to clearance but I don't see Final Sale on my receipt. Can I return it?

Yes! Since the top doesn't have the Final Sale designation on your receipt, you can return it within 30 days of delivery as long as it's unworn, unwashed, and has the tags attached. Just keep in mind there's a $6.95 return shipping fee that's deducted from your refund.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Hi, I think my order is lost in transit. The tracking shows it left the warehouse 11 business days ago but nothing since.

Since your order hasn't arrived within 10 business days of shipping, please contact our support team so we can open a carrier trace. We'll then reship your order or issue a refund once the trace is complete.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Why do I only get 14 days to return my international order when domestic gets 30? That seems unfair.

I understand that feels unfair. International orders have a 14-day return window, while domestic returns allow 30 days, and international customers are responsible for return shipping with duties and taxes non-refundable. If you'd like to discuss this further, I'm happy to connect you with a human agent.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My order #AC-8842 shipped 10 business days ago and never showed up. I'd like a refund or replacement please.
Since your order hasn't arrived within 10 business days of shipping, I'll open a carrier trace for you right away. Once the trace is complete, we can reship your items or issue a refund.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered two candles on Friday and they're both $8 cheaper today. It's only been 3 days so I'd like a one-time price adjustment please.

You're in luck! According to our policy, if an item you bought drops in price within 7 days of purchase, you can get a one-time price adjustment. Since it's only been 3 days, you are well within the window, and I'd be happy to help you get that process started.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My refund was issued, but my bank says it could take a few more days—is that normal?
Yes, that’s normal—once we’ve issued the refund, your bank may take a little extra time to post it. Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I returned a gift last week with the gift receipt and haven't received my store credit yet. How long does this usually take?

Gift returns with a gift receipt are refunded as store credit at the price paid. Refunds are processed within 7 business days of us receiving your return, so if it's been longer than that since we received it, I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent to check on the status!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My package was delivered damaged and the ceramic mug inside is shattered. I've already emailed photos to support but haven't heard back. Can someone help me?

I’m sorry your mug arrived shattered—defective or damaged items reported within 90 days of delivery qualify for a refund or replacement, and we cover return shipping. Since you already sent photos, a human agent will review your case and follow up with you.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Quick question - if I return two items from the same order, is it $6.95 total or per item?

The $6.95 return shipping fee is a flat rate per return shipment, so returning two items from the same order together costs $6.95 total, deducted from your refund. Start your return in the returns portal and you'll get a prepaid label.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I bought this jacket online last week and it's too big, can I just take it to your downtown store instead of mailing it back?

Yes, you can return it to any Alder & Co. Store, including the downtown location, since it's within the 30-day return window. Online purchases can be returned in-store, and there's no return shipping fee for store returns. Just make sure the jacket is unworn, unwashed, and has the tags attached.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
The portal says my item is outside the return window but I only got it 3 weeks ago. The delivery date in your system is wrong.

I can help with that. Our return window is 30 days from delivery, so 3 weeks should still be eligible if the delivery date is incorrect. Please contact support with your order number and proof of delivery so we can update the date and process your return.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered two sizes of the same jeans to try at home and want to return one and exchange the other for a different wash.

You can return the unworn pair with tags attached within 30 days of delivery, and you can also exchange the other pair for a different wash within that same window, subject to stock. The return has a $6.95 shipping fee, but the exchange ships free. You can start both in the returns portal.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
There's a stain on the blouse I ordered that wasn't there in the product photos. Do I need to send it back or can you just refund me?

I'm sorry about the stain on your blouse! Since it arrived damaged, you can report it within 90 days of delivery with a photo, and we'll cover the return shipping—just choose between a refund or replacement.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I ordered a jacket from Toronto and it arrived yesterday but it’s way too big, can I still send it back even though I’m outside the US?

Yes, you can return it, but because it’s an international order, you have 14 days from delivery to send it back. You’ll be responsible for the return shipping costs, and any duties or taxes you paid won’t be refunded.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Do you offer gift wrapping services? This is a birthday present for my mom.
I don't have information about gift wrapping services, but I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent who can help with that!
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
My grandmother sent me a shirt directly from your website. I know her order number. If I return it as a gift, how long does it take to get the store credit?

Gift returns with an order number are refunded as store credit at the price paid, and refunds are processed within 7 business days of us receiving your return. I don't have specific timing for when store credit is issued after processing, so I can connect you with a human agent for more details if needed.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
I used a gift card and a credit card to pay—how will the refund be split?

Refunds go to the original payment method, so the refund would be split between the gift card and credit card based on how you paid. For the exact split, please contact support or check the returns portal.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Just wondering if the 7 business days for refunds starts when I ship the item or when you receive it.
The 7 business days for refunds starts when we receive your return, not when you ship it. Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days of us receiving your return.
You are the customer support assistant for Alder & Co., an apparel retailer. Keep answers short and friendly.
Is there a time limit on returning online purchases to your stores? I got my delivery three weeks ago and haven't had a chance to get to the mall yet.

Yes, you can return online purchases to any Alder & Co. Store within 30 days of delivery, as long as the items are unworn, unwashed, and have the tags attached. Since you received your delivery three weeks ago, you still have about a week left, and store returns have no return shipping fee.
